notes: Six more app languages: Simplified Chinese (简体中文), French, German, Portuguese, Japanese and Korean, beside Traditional Chinese and Spanish. Choose one in Settings, Display, App language.
Each covers the same first screens: the sidebar, Today, the welcome, Find anything, Help and the feedback page students get. The other screens are still in English.
None of the translations has been checked by a fluent speaker yet, so a line may read oddly.
